projects.name: Alexandroff property and composant foundations
projects.scope: Alexandroff property of metric indecomposable continua and eight classical composant results.

projects.name: Order arcs between subcontinua
projects.scope: Embedded increasing interval between strictly nested subcontinua of compact metric spaces.

projects.name: Path components of punctured continuum hyperspaces
projects.scope: Path classification by composants and uncountably many path components.

projects.name: Sorgenfrey covering theorems
projects.scope: Hereditary Lindelofness and paracompactness, disjoint clopen refinements, and plane non-Lindelofness and non-paracompactness.

projects.name: Whitney reversibility of hereditary decomposability
projects.scope: Sequential strong Whitney reversibility, assuming a Whitney map, and relative indecomposable level families.

projects.name: Michael's biquotient-map theorems
projects.scope: Arbitrary biquotient products and the full Hausdorff-target identity-product characterization.

projects.name: Dowker's characterization
projects.scope: Normality and countable paracompactness, interval-product normality, strict insertion, and compact metrizable products.

projects.name: Perfect surjections and paracompactness
projects.scope: Preservation and reflection of paracompactness, image separation, and locally finite refinements.

projects.name: Full Nagata-Smirnov metrization
projects.scope: Regular Hausdorff metrization iff a sigma locally finite open basis exists, with arbitrary layer cardinality.

projects.name: Smirnov local-to-global metrization
projects.scope: Metrizability iff Hausdorff, paracompact and locally metrizable; point-finite-cover basis construction.

projects.name: Perfect images of metrizable spaces
projects.scope: Perfect continuous images of arbitrary metrizable spaces, uniform compact-fiber neighborhoods, image basis and compatible metric.

projects.name: Alexandroff–Urysohn cover metrization
projects.scope: Intersecting-pair open-cover criterion, separation-free pseudometric form, co-membership uniformity and compatible metric.

projects.name: Sneider's Gδ-diagonal metrization theorem
projects.scope: Compact Hausdorff metrizability iff a Gδ diagonal, cofinal closed-neighborhood basis and exact compatible metric; canonical verification and rendering passed.

projects.name: Compact Hausdorff countable-network metrization
projects.scope: Compact Hausdorff metrizability and second countability iff a countable network exists; bounded separating functions, exact metric and network transport.

projects.name: Countable-coordinate factorization for compact products
projects.scope: Continuous countable-subproduct factorization, uniform-space bridge, common factors and compact-product metrizability.

projects.name: Countable-density Hewitt–Marczewski–Pondiczery theorem
projects.scope: Continuum-index separable products by finite-pattern rows, with exact discrete Boolean-cube sharpness.

projects.name: Fréchet–Urysohn Σ-products of first-countable spaces
projects.scope: Adaptive sequential closure for countable-support products, T1 support control and the nonsequential Boolean-cube contrast.
